body:
Accepted both status-model blockers and one additional independent-review blocker.

Fresh draft: SHA-256 eff6a98e1f1c663be71d5048755dba1ed805ba68ed247b20cef1179224e14507, 279 lines; whitespace check clean.

Changes:
- Selection vocabulary now contains only Nominated, CandidateOnly, Deferred, and Excluded.
- pyannote is Deferred on Selection and OwnerActionRequired only on Rights/access, linked to the chief owner-action bead.
- Conditional is now explicitly defined as a mixed-leaf registry summary that never grants use; every required non-admitted leaf keeps the component unavailable.
- Court authorization is now orthogonal to all five component axes. Held / future Authorized(bead, scope) is defined separately, and the FFmpeg/PySceneDetect Rights rows no longer mix execution state into rights.

Please rescan this exact hash. No package, media, term, artifact, execution, overall B0, P1, or C1 authorization is claimed.
